name: roadworthy
description: Guardrails for agentic coding: one change, zero collateral damage. Scope-locked edits, refutation-tested guarantees, evidence-gated commits and plan reviews, enforced by hooks rather than by prose.

principles_file.title: Principles file
principles_file.description: Markdown file whose numbered lines (`1. ...`) are injected at every prompt. Leave empty to use the principles bundled with the plugin.

project_rules.title: Inject project rules
project_rules.description: Also inject the numbered lines of the current project's auto-memory MEMORY.md as a second layer.

protected_paths.title: Protected paths
protected_paths.description: Comma-separated glob patterns that Edit/Write may never touch (e.g. `lib/ble/**,**/permissions.dart`). Empty disables the guard.

scope_lock.title: Scope lock
scope_lock.description: While a plan scope file exists in the project (`.roadworthy/scope`), deny edits to files outside the declared scope.

rite_gate.title: Require a front before any write
rite_gate.description: Deny edits and shell writes while the project has no usable .roadworthy/scope, and deny writes to the files only a script may write. Turning this off restores the behaviour measured on 2026-09-13: 60 edits and 117 commands in a day with no rite invoked and nothing noticing.

stop_gate.title: Block a finished claim on stale gates
stop_gate.description: When a turn says the work is finished and the project declares gates, block it while close.sh --check does not report every gate FRESH. Never blocks a project with no gates file, never blocks twice on the same tree, and fails open on any error.

forbidden_commit_flags.title: Forbidden commit flags
forbidden_commit_flags.description: Comma-separated flags that must never appear in a git commit command.

block_empty_commits.title: Block empty commits
block_empty_commits.description: Deny `git commit` when nothing is staged.

plan_review_required.title: Require plan review
plan_review_required.description: Deny ExitPlanMode unless the plan's review file (by name) records VERDICT: APPROVED; REJECTED and ESCALATE deny, and a round beyond the ceiling needs the user's owner: decision.

plan_gate.title: What guards a plan
plan_gate.description: One of preflight, review, both. preflight: the plan is checked mechanically (citations by content, whole-file reading proved from the transcript, scope paths, acceptance numbering, declared corrections). review: an adversarial reviewer's APPROVED verdict, the pre-0.6.0 behaviour. both: the two. The cold reviewer's own principle says a fix is refuted on the DIFF, so a machine guards the plan and the reader guards the change.

max_review_rounds.title: Review rounds ceiling
max_review_rounds.description: Rounds of cold review a plan may take before only the user's written decision (an owner: line in the review) unlocks it.

review_suffix.title: Review file suffix
review_suffix.description: Suffix of the review file that sits next to a plan (`<plan><suffix>`).

plans_dir.title: Plans directory
plans_dir.description: Where Claude Code writes plan-mode plans. Leave empty for ~/.claude/plans.
